indications.name: Moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older who weigh at least 40 kg whose disease is not adequately controlled with topical prescription therapies or when those therapies are not advisable

pivotal.indication: Moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older who weigh at least 40 kg whose disease is not adequately controlled with topical prescription therapies or when those therapies are not advisable
pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-08: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: Three multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials, ADvocate 1, ADvocate 2 and ADhere (NCT04146363, NCT04178967, NCT04250337) enrolled a total of 1062 subjects 12 years of age and older with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis
